description: This file defines the Git::SVN::GlobSpec class, which handles parsing and matching of glob patterns used for file path matching in a version control context.

classes.name: Git::SVN::GlobSpec
classes.description: A class representing a glob pattern with methods to parse and match file paths based on the pattern.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new GlobSpec instance, parsing the provided glob pattern into internal regex components.

methods.name: full_path
methods.description: Generates the full path by combining the left part, the provided path, and the right part of the glob pattern.
